text: Praise ye Jah. Praise ye the name of Jehovah; praise, ye servants of Jehovah,
Standing in the house of Jehovah, in the enclosures of the house of our God.
Praise ye Jah; for Jehovah is good: play on the harp to his name, for it is pleasant.
For Jah chose to himself Jacob; Israel for his property.
For I knew that great is Jehovah, and our Lord above all gods.
All which Jehovah delighted in he did, in the heavens and in the earth, in the seas and all the depths.
Causing the liftings up to ascend from the ends of the earth; he made lightnings for the rain; bringing forth the wind from his treasures.
He struck the first-born of Egypt, from man even to cattle.
He sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
He struck many nations, and slew strong kings;
To Sihon, king of the Amorites, and to Og, king of Bashan, and to all the kings of Canaan:
And he gave their land an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel his people.
O Jehovah, thy name is forever; O Jehovah, thy remembrance to generation and generation.
For Jehovah will judge his people, and he will compassion upon his servants.
The images of the nation are silver and gold, the work of man’s hands.
A mouth to them, and they shall not speak; eyes to them, and they shall not see;
Ears to them, and they shall not hear; also there is no spirit in their mouth.
They making them shall be as they: every one who trusted in them.
O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah: O house of Aaron, praise ye Jehovah:
O house of Levi, praise ye Jehovah: ye fearing Jehovah, praise Jehovah.
Blessed be Jehovah from Zion, dwelling in Jerusalem. Praise ye Jah.
